text.p: The Brussels Stock Exchange resumed trade on Thursday after an almost two hours opening delay due to the New Year date change.

The bourse failed to open at 0900 GMT because orders which were placed on December 30, the last trading day of 1996, had been recognised by the bourse's computer trading system as originating in December 1997.
Brussels leading Bel-20 share index .BFX which opened down 0.14 percent was down 0.15 percent or 2.81 points to 1,892.68 at 1200 GMT.
